events.title: OpenOffice.org 1.0 released
events.summary: [OpenOffice].org 1.0 shipped on May 1, 2002 — [Sun]'s open-source office suite forked from StarOffice.
events.about: [OpenOffice] brought free word processors and spreadsheets to Linux desktops and challenged [Microsoft] Office lock-in. Its OpenDocument format influenced [ISO] standards and later LibreOffice — proving open-source could ship full productivity suites.

narrative.whyChosen: [OpenOffice] was the flagship open-source alternative to [Microsoft] Office.
narrative.whyImportant: It advanced open document formats and desktop software freedom.
narrative.problemSolved: Linux users lacked a credible free office suite compatible with common file formats.
